Born: August 16, 1958, 7:05 AM local time, Bay City, Michigan, USA. Source: Astro-Databank, Rodden rating AA.

The AA rating means the time comes from a birth record, so the rising sign, the Midheaven and the houses below can be read at face value. Open Madonna's chart on Astrolas to follow the wheel while you read.

One sign carries more weight than any other in this chart. h Virgo holds three planets, the Moon, Mercury and Pluto, and the rising sign itself sits in Virgo too. Two of those three planets sit close enough to the Ascendant to form an exact contact with it. That is an unusually concentrated chart, and it lines up with a public career built on rehearsal, control and reinvention on a schedule of her own choosing.

Second in line is a smaller group in Leo: the Sun, Venus and Uranus, two of them tucked into the private 12th house. Between the Virgo weight up front and the Leo planets working behind the scenes, this chart reads as someone who plans meticulously in private and then steps into the light exactly when ready.

muc.ten: Virgo rising, with the Moon and Mercury folded into it
doan: The Ascendant sits at 8°15' Virgo. The Astrolas library does not have an entry for Virgo rising on its own, so this reading leans on what sits right next to it: the Moon at 11°33' Virgo and E Mercury , retrograde, at 5°39' Virgo. Both are close enough to form a conjunction with the Ascendant, Mercury at an orb of 2°36' and the Moon at 3°17'.

The library reads Mercury conjunct the Ascendant as a mind built for talk, reasoning and writing, one that gathers information constantly and needs an outlet, whether through lists, exercise, or some other way of discharging mental pressure. Since this Mercury is retrograde and sitting in the 12th house, that reasoning stays mostly private: the library describes Mercury retrograde in the 12th as introspective, self-doubting about how it comes across, careful with contracts and paperwork, and more trusting of intuition than of what is said out loud. Madonna has spent decades managing her own image and catalog with unusual precision, timing album releases and visuals for maximum effect, while giving famously few interviews that explain the thinking behind any of it.

Moon conjunct the Ascendant, in the library's reading, makes someone approachable, easily picking up the emotional temperature of a room, sensitive to being liked, yet still anchored to a personal code it will not abandon just to fit in. The Moon in Virgo itself adds sharp, practical self-discipline: a need for order, a tendency toward self-criticism, and comfort that comes from routine rather than chaos. Before any of her albums existed, Madonna trained formally as a dancer, including a stint with the Alvin Ailey company in New York, the kind of discipline that a Virgo rising and a Virgo Moon describe well: rehearsal as the real safety net.
Zodiac sign Virgo Earth · Mutable · Mercury The diagnostician. The one who sees the flaw and fixes it.
Planet Mercury Rules Gemini, Virgo Communication, thinking, flexibility
Planet Pluto Rules Scorpio Transformation, rebirth, power
Zodiac sign Leo Fire · Fixed · Sun The performer. The one who needs to be seen.

P Pluto sits at 1°43' Virgo, also in the 12th house. On a generational level, the library ties Pluto in Virgo to the 1957 to 1971 cohort and a restructuring of work, health and daily service, so this placement is shared with an entire generation rather than unique to her. It becomes personal through the house and through a tight conjunction to Mercury, orb 3°56'.

The library reads Mercury conjunct Pluto as a mind that digs, that keeps secrets well, and that thinks strategically enough to stay ahead of rivals, the profile of a researcher, an investigative reporter, or in the library's own phrase, a detective. It also names a shadow side: a pull toward manipulation, from either direction, worth watching. Pluto in the 12th house on its own reads as an intense inner life, strong intuition turned toward understanding people, and a gift for working quietly that can tip into suspicion if left unchecked. Across a career spent reshaping her own image again and again, holding onto ownership of her catalog, and running her business affairs with a reputation for toughness, that mix of sharp private thinking and a drive to stay in control fits.

One more contact belongs here even without library text yet: Neptune in Scorpio sextiles Pluto at an orb of just 0°35', the tightest link in the whole chart. The library has no entry for this pairing, so it is worth naming only as wiring between a generational Scorpio Neptune and the Virgo group next door.

muc.ten: Sun and Uranus in Leo, kept inside the 12th house
doan: The Sun sits at 23°07' g Leo , and Uranus at 12°42' Leo, both in the 12th house. Leo on its own, in the library's reading, is radiant, magnetic, built to be the center of attention, loyal and generous, but vulnerable to a need for recognition that can tip into pride. Uranus in Leo, generational for her entire cohort, adds a restless creative drive and a need to be seen as singular, personal here through the 12th house and through a wide square to Mars, orb 2°41', which the library has no text for yet.

Both land in the 12th house, which the library ties to privacy and working behind the scenes, with real recognition often arriving only once that inner strength comes out. That is an odd fit on paper for a performer this visible, except that it matches a documented pattern: long stretches of rehearsal before each public reinvention. Her breakthrough came in her mid-twenties with the self-titled 1983 album, and the sound and image changed sharply from one era to the next: 1984's Like a Virgin, 1990's Vogue and the Blond Ambition tour, 1998's Ray of Light.

R Venus sits at 0°32' Leo, in the 11th house. The library's Venus in Leo wants a love that feels dramatic and admired, generous in both directions, with devotion expected in return. Venus in the 11th house ties romance and money to the social network: luck can arrive through groups, clubs or shared creative circles.

Her first real public identity came inside a group rather than solo. Before her recording deal, she worked in bands in New York's club scene, and some of her most celebrated records, including Ray of Light and later Confessions on a Dance Floor, were built through close collaboration with specific producers rather than alone. The library's note about love and luck through groups fits a career spent largely inside the entertainment industry's social orbit, working alongside the same handful of producers across decades.

Y Jupiter sits at 26°24' Libra, in the 2nd house. The library reads Jupiter in Libra as charm and natural diplomacy, with luck often arriving through partnership and collaboration, plus an eye for aesthetics that can show up as real artistic talent. In the 2nd house, that luck becomes financial: steady, if sometimes quiet, with income that can come through family, a partner, or assets that are not easy to touch quickly.

Across a career built on licensing, touring and a back catalog that keeps generating income decades after release, that reads less like one lucky break and more like compounding returns on work already banked, close to the 2nd-house pattern the library describes.

muc.ten: Saturn in Sagittarius, and Mars in Taurus
doan: Saturn sits at 19°09' Sagittarius, retrograde, in the 4th house. The library ties Saturn in Sagittarius to success that arrives late, after a long apprenticeship in patience, often leading toward teaching, publishing or some other platform built on hard-won belief. In the 4th house, it adds a demanding, not always easy, childhood that produces self-reliance and, eventually, a strong pull toward building a stable home of one's own.

Mars sits at 15°23' Taurus, in the 9th house. The library's Mars in Taurus is slow, steady and almost impossible to talk out of a decision once it is made, built for the long game rather than a sprint. In the 9th house, that same drive turns toward belief systems and higher learning, with a tendency to defend personal convictions fiercely. Both placements point to a season of effort that pays off only gradually, which matches an early career spent studying dance and working ordinary jobs in New York for several years before any real break arrived.

muc.ten: What the chart adds up to
doan: The chart does not explain talent or taste. What it does show is a structure: a Virgo rising wrapped around a Virgo Moon, Mercury and Pluto, built for planning and control, paired with a quieter Leo cluster tucked into the 12th house that only shows its hand once the rehearsal is finished. Read the Virgo group against the career's pattern of long private preparation before each public reinvention, and the two line up.
